report:
Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. There is a large bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus seen displaced into midline. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved.  Incidental note is made of a micro loculated ganglion possibly arising from the semimembranosus insertion level.  
Conclusion: Displaced bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus. No evidence of ligamentous disruption. Posteromedial ganglion formation possibly arising from the semimembranosus tendon insertion.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağda düşük dereceli parsiyel yırtık izleniyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyal ve lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Komplexer Riss des Innenmeniskus mit horizontaler Komponente im Vorder- und Hinterhorn und longitudinaler Komponente mit Substanzverlust in der Pars intermedia (Serie 4/ Image 21). Reizzustand des MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenamrksignal. Vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt in der medialen Patellafacette mit subchondralem Osteophyten (Serie 7/ Image 11). Kein subchondrales Ödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patellarsehne und der Quadrizepssehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Geringer Gelenkerguss. Rupturierte Baker-Zyste.

Kein vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Substanzdefekt am Übergang der Pars intermedia zum Hinterhorn des Innenmeniskus mit mukoider Degeneration. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile: 
Geringer Gelenkerguss.

Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial.
Condropatía superficial del resto de los compartimentos femorotibiales. Cartílago troclear sin
alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la rótula de distribución difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo, con probable filtración hacia
caudal.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Discreto edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía superficial del resto de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Pequeño quiste poplíteo con probable filtración hacia caudal.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.16 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Minimal degenerative subchondral changes at the patellofemoral joint. Otherwise, bone marrow signal is normal. No acute fracture or bone bruise. 

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear extending along the body and posterior horn, with mild extrusion. A flap fragment is displaced from the posterior horn toward the intercondylar notch.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and irregularity, most prominent at the posterior weightbearing aspect with a small chondral flap at the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There are small tears at the anterior and posterior root attachments. No extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the medial patellar facet. Lateral patellar cartilage appears intact. Moderate to severe cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the medial and central trochlea. Minimal subchondral edema and cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinosis.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complex medial meniscal tear with extrusion and displaced flap fragment. Small tears at the anterior and posterior root attachments of the lateral meniscus.

2. Chondrosis in the patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartment.

3. Mild quadriceps tendinosis.

4. Small joint effusion. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS




> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
> The contour of ACL and MCL in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Fluid accumulation along proximal LCL and popliteus tendon with mild increased singal of the tendon/ ligament on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury and mild bursitis.
> Bone marrow edema in medial tibial tuberosity, more prominent at subchondral region.
> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, with internal septums and mild perifocal edema, in favor of Baker's cyst, more than 7 cm in length.
> Increased fat stranding along the pes anserinus, R/O paratendinitis.
> Mild irregular contour of articular surface of patella, in favor of grade 2 chondromalacia.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with medial/ lateral plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Mild subcutaneous edema over anterior aspect of knee.
 
Impression: 
1. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
2. Grade 1 injury of ACL and MCL.
   Grade 1 injury of proximal popliteus tendon and LCL with adjacent bursitis(Srs/Img: [ID]/21)
3. Mild synovitis of left knee and prominent Baker's cyst with mild perifocal edema; patellar plicae.
4. Mild paratendinitis of pes anserinus; mild bursitis abutting proximal LCL.
5. Grade 2 chondromalacia of patella and medial femorotibial joint.
6. Bone marrow edmea over medial tibial plateua.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Arthrose modérée du compartiment médial avec chondropatie modérée à sévère du condyle fémoral médial portant et du plateau tibial médial, avec zones d'exposition de l'os sous-chondral et œdème osseux associé et petits kystes sous-chondraux.
Légère chondropatie du compartiment latéral sans fissuration profonde. Zone focale de chondropatie modérée dans la gorge trochléaire, sans chondropatie rétropatellaire significative.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs sans particularité.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Normal.

Ménisque médial : Macération dégénérative sévère avec déchirure multidirectionnelle impliquant le corps méniscal, une petite déchirure horizontale oblique s'étend dans les cornes antérieures et postérieures.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normaux.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normaux.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral : Normaux.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Petit kyste de Baker non compliqué.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Petits corps intra-articulaires libres dégénératifs dans le récessus articulaire postérieur mesurant jusqu'à 5 mm.

CONCLUSION :
Arthrose modérée du compartiment médial avec chondropatie modérée à sévère telle que décrite, et petits corps libres dégénératifs dans le récessus articulaire postérieur.
Macération dégénérative sévère et déchirure multidirectionnelle du ménisque médial impliquant principalement le corps méniscal.
Petit kyste de Baker non compliqué.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] female presenting with right-sided knee discomfort and recurrent patellar dislocations. Her x-rays and ultrasound did not show any significant findings.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact without evidence of significant partial or full-thickness tear.

The articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates mild chondral fraying and signal change involving the lateral facet consistent with mild-to-moderate chondromalacia patella. The trochlear surface appears intact and unremarkable.

There is edema within the suprapatellar fat pad. This finding may be seen in the context of extensor mechanism impingement.

The TT-TG distance is within normal limits without evidence of lateralization of tibial tubercle. No obvious MR features of transient lateral dislocation of the patella.

The lateral meniscus is intact and unremarkable. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact and appears unremarkable. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex are intact and appear unremarkable.

There is a trace Baker's cyst present.

There is a small popliteal cyst seen deep to the medial head of the gastrocnemius within the intercondylar notch of the femur measuring about 10 x 8 mm.

No evidence of a significant knee effusion.

Marrow signal is normal.

INTERPRETATION: 

Mild to moderate chondromalacia patella.

There is edema within the suprapatellar fat pad which may be associated with symptomatic impingement in the extensor mechanism.

Small Baker's cyst.

No evidence of of internal derangement.

No obvious anatomic features predisposing to lateral dislocation of the patella or evidence of posttraumatic changes related to transient lateral dislocation of the patella.
